scientific_integrity: The exact probability formulas are justified by a symbolic rank argument. Tests exhaustively enumerate only explicitly identified small cases and otherwise use seeded reproducible sampling; no stochastic sample is treated as universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the split traceless upper-triangular 3x3 Lie algebra; no general theorem for higher-rank Borel algebras, arbitrary solvable Lie algebras, group generation, or nonuniform sampling. Historical priority and independent verification remain unconfirmed. Seeded trials are not exhaustive.
title: Exact generating-tuple probabilities for the rank-two Borel Lie algebra over finite fields
